title: merge-index note union must keep same-timestamp notes in union order
lead: s250's note union in `merge-index` has two small gaps, found by its review gate:

- Notes that share a timestamp are reordered by id.
- The getting-started docs leave out one conflict case.
findings_note: s250 gate nits, 2026-10-11: TypeError on non-string created_at; same-second notes reordered by id; getting-started omits delete-vs-edit
boundary: **Not in this slice:** per-note conflict paths; merging non-note fields; repairing projects whose .gitattributes lacks the index.json line.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
**Not a crash.** `_load` (`src/slicer/mergeindex.py:52`) runs `Index.from_dict` on all three inputs, and `NoteRecord.from_dict` (`src/slicer/model.py:204`) refuses a `created_at` that is not a string as `corrupt`. `_load` then raises `_Unreadable`, so `merge()` takes the text-merge fallback before `_note_records` runs. A `null` `created_at` on ours exits 1 with conflict markers and no traceback, so no guard is needed.

**The reorder.** On the union path, notes that share a `created_at` are re-sorted by id instead of keeping union order: ours' notes, then the notes only theirs has. In `_note_records`, the `sorted` call (`src/slicer/mergeindex.py:158`) used the key `(created_at, id)`, which caused it. Base `[nz, na]` at one timestamp, with ours adding `no` and theirs adding `nt`, merges to `[na, no, nt, nz]`, not `[nz, na, no, nt]`.

**The docs gap.** `docs/getting-started.md:703` lists "one note edited two ways" as a conflict, but not "a note removed on one side and edited on the other".

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/mergeindex.py`:
  - Sort by `created_at` only, relying on Python's stable sort, so notes that share a timestamp keep union order: ours' notes, then the notes only theirs has. The module docstring and the `_note_records` docstring state the new key.
- `docs/getting-started.md`: the merge sentence gives creation time with ties yours first. The conflict list adds the delete-vs-edit case. Verified by review, since no getting-started prose test exists.
- `docs/commands.md`: the `merge-index` row gives the same sort wording.
- `tests/test_merge_index.py`.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: amend the s250 `merge-index` note bullet under [Unreleased].

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `test_MergeIndex_SameTimestampNotes_KeepUnionOrder`

The getting-started line is verified by review. No getting-started prose test exists; `tests/test_docs_coverage.py` checks command-table rows only.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the test and watch it fail.
2. Change the sort key.
3. Update the docs, the docstrings and the changelog.
4. Run `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite, then `slicer check`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `feature/s251-merge-notes-edges` in `.worktrees/s251`. Do not commit, merge or push until the owner asks. This repo finishes with `handoff`.
